g.text: SwiftDrop Core API - Parcel Management & Pricing
Handles merchant order intake & delegates booking
Consumes tracking milestones for SSE & public read
Relays committed outbox events to RabbitMQ
and idempotency headers, serializes REST responses
and dimensions, serializes fee estimation quotes
Coordinates delivery fee estimation, quote caching,
Calculates delivery fees using approved tariffs
Validates JWT tokens & injects authenticated caller claims
